data.name: Izumimoto Eimi
data.description:
A member of the Paranormal Affairs Department of Millennium Academy. She's a quiet girl and others have trouble with what she's thinking.

She often stands around vacantly for no reason. However, when entrusted with a mission, she is able to execute her objective by moving more efficiently than anyone else.

Personality: Always striving for efficiency, Eimi often does things that most people wouldn't. She also spends most of her time alone, except when she's with Himari.

Appearance: She wears a short skirt and what looks like a bikini with zippers. She wears a white shirt-vest and a black jacket with cargo-pants type button covered pockets. She seems to have long hair, and has tall socks and what look like a pair of running shoes.

Halo: Eimi's halo is a pink dual circle with bridges connected together inside a dashed circle with two side lines edged.

Uniform: She has fluffy pink hair, about reaching in her waistline with a red clip on her left bangs. She has dark pink eyes.

She wears a heavy red and black jacket with a similar colored striped belts. She has white unbuttoned dress that revealed her black undergarments strapped with black ammunition belt with a Millennium access badge and a striped red tie.

She wears black socks and shoes with white shoelaces and soles and bandage patches in her shoulder and right knee.

Firearm: She uses a three-tone Franchi SPAS-12 shotgun with a white barrel and shroud, black forearm and tube magazine, and a red receiver and grip. An orange Millennium stamp is stickered on the receiver. Another orange Millennium tag hangs on the forearm.

Age: 15

Birthday: May 1st

Height: 167 cm

School Year: First Year

Club: Paranormal Affairs Department

Hobby: Daydreaming, Listening to Music
